label: One selected own-being giver supplies every actual participant in esse and is unique in that role
paraphrase: Analyst formulation of the principal-giver reading. There is an actual participant. For every actual q44 participant x, the same selected s is distinct, actual, its own subsistent being and a cause of x's esse. Every distinct actual own-being giver of x's esse equals s. Principal giver here means a giver in precisely that qualified class; using the statement with a different account of principal giving needs a bridge. Secondary causes can act in producing an effect. The q3 cause relation is mode-unspecified. The selected source's efficiency, totality and degree remain distinct questions.
